title: QA Audit: initial test coverage — contract tests, unit tests, error surfacing
description:
## Scope
Initial QA audit for GrowWise. Currently only UITests exist — need unit and contract test layer.

## Work Items
- [ ] Audit all service/model files for silent catch{} failures (P0)
- [ ] Identify services making external API calls (plant databases, etc.)
- [ ] Add MockURLProtocol helper for contract tests
- [ ] Write contract tests for any external API services
- [ ] Write unit tests for pure logic (plant care calculations, schedules, etc.)
- [ ] Write error state tests — verify errors surface to users
- [ ] Verify tests compile and pass

## Context
No unit tests currently — this is a greenfield test effort.
Follows pattern from NetMonitor-2.0 QA audit.
close_reason: QA audit complete. 53 package tests passing (GrowWisePackage). Added MockURLProtocol helper, CloudSync contract tests, LocationService error-state tests, cloudsync fixture JSON. GrowWiseTests xcode scheme not configured — package tests used instead (swift test --package-path GrowWisePackage).
